problem.text: Sampling-step classes lacked short descriptions of their roles.

reasoning.text: The change adds nine class docstrings and a TODO about removing redundant steps and fusing operations; it does not implement those optimizations.

impact.text: Sampling computations, defaults and interfaces remain unchanged. The new top-p description does not match the existing cutoff implementation.

source_notes.text: The parent annotation identified a sorted-argmax assignment problem.

Issue #7, “quantizing model: undefined symbol: __cxa_call_terminate,” discusses extension loading. Issue #15, “`cogito-v1-preview-qwen-32B` generates incoherent output for bpw <= 2.5,” discusses quantization and regularization; neither discussion states a connection to this comments-only change.

limitations: The numerical check transcribes the cutoff using standard-library Python, not PyTorch or CUDA; its binary-exact inputs avoid rounding ambiguity.
No repository execution, sampling-frequency measurement or performance benchmark was performed.

chapters.title: Document sampling steps without changing execution

claims.text: The descriptions distinguish no-op, greedy selection, categorical sampling, temperature scaling, normalization, sorting and three truncation filters. SS_Sample adds Gumbel noise through extension calls before argmax and maps sorted positions back to token IDs.

Temperature divides logits or raises probability weights to the reciprocal temperature. Normalization uses softmax for logits and division by row sums for weights. Sorting records token indices alongside descending values; its new docstring ends with the unexplained fragment “state.indices”.

Top-k masks sorted positions after K, using zero for probabilities or negative infinity for logits. Min-p instead retains probabilities greater than or equal to min_p times the row maximum, so equality survives and sorting is unnecessary for its unsorted branch.

CustomSampler inserts prerequisites requested by each step, executes the resulting list and reshapes the final sample. Its construction-time planning state remains INIT throughout, while runtime steps track normalization and sorting. The new TODO proposes future redundancy elimination and fusion rather than changing this mechanism.
For probabilities [0.5, 0.25, 0.125, 0.125] and P=0.625, a scalar transcription retained only mass 0.5; the newly documented smallest prefix exceeding P would retain mass 0.75.

findings.description: The new top-p docstring promises a crossing token that the existing implementation generally excludes.
findings.trigger: A normalized sorted distribution crosses P after its first token, for example [0.5, 0.25, 0.125, 0.125] with P=0.625.
findings.expected_behavior: Under the new description, retain the smallest leading set whose cumulative probability exceeds P: the first two tokens in this example.
findings.actual_behavior: The implementation preserves the first token unconditionally and retains subsequent tokens only when their inclusive cumulative probability is <= P, leaving just the first token in this example.

verification.description: Whole-parent-tree search found TopPSampler constructing this step in both temperature-order branches. CustomSampler.forward directly invokes step.run. The existing preset docstring describes <= P with at least one candidate; DefaultSampler uses min-p instead.
verification.limits: External custom compositions were not inventoried.

verification.description: Computed inclusive cumulative sums and reproduced the unshifted mask, then compared it with the documented crossing-prefix rule.
verification.limits: Standard-library scalar model, not repository execution.

findings.description: The sorted-argmax problem identified in the parent annotation is carried over unchanged despite the new selection docstring.
findings.trigger: A custom chain reaches SS_Argmax.run with sorted logits or probabilities.
findings.expected_behavior: Map each row's selected position to its token ID and populate state.sample.
findings.actual_behavior: Sorted branches assign indexed values to state.state instead of state.sample, then overwrite state.state with DONE. If indexing completes, forward still cannot reshape the unset sample.

verification.description: Compared parent implementation with the comments-only diff. Whole-parent-tree SS_Argmax search and preset inspection found built-in constructions starting directly from INIT; CustomSampler.forward is the direct step runner. Reach therefore includes custom sorted-greedy chains, not the inspected built-in greedy branches.
verification.limits: No runtime reproduction or external caller inventory.

annotation.summary: Documents sampling-step roles and future optimization work without changing execution; the top-p description conflicts with its cutoff logic, and sorted argmax remains unchanged.

argv:
import itertools,json
p=[0.5,0.25,0.125,0.125]; t=0.625
c=list(itertools.accumulate(p)); actual=[p[0]]+[x if s<=t else 0 for x,s in zip(p[1:],c[1:])]
n=next(i+1 for i,s in enumerate(c) if s>t)
print(json.dumps({'probabilities':p,'top_p':t,'cumulative':c,'implementation_retained':actual,'implementation_mass':sum(actual),'documented_smallest_prefix':p[:n],'documented_mass':sum(p[:n])}))
